card.name: Digits inside phone and ZIP numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (usually 1 or 2) in the middle of a ZIP code or phone number, such as a US ZIP in a trial site list or a poison-center hotline number.

modes.label: ZIP codes
modes.description: A digit inside a five-digit US ZIP code after a state name in trial site listings or addresses.

modes.label: Hotline numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a poison-center or helpline phone number in overdose text.
